Shot List

    Examples taken from The Concise Book of Position Play by Bill Smith

    End rail play

    End rail and come in short

    Very easy to over hit this shot. Think about the path of the red ball and try to keep it traveling across the table rather than cutting it finer.

    End rail outside

    I found I had to play this shot thinner than I expected to keep the red ball near the left cushion and not travelling down the table too far.
